reasons: Claimed status (missing) is supported: the cited paragraphs and rationale show no limitation-of-liability, damages-exclusion or aggregate-liability language anywhere, so an added clause is the appropriate remedy.

The inserted Section 10.9 reaches the preferred position: mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable by the Company and USD 1,000,000, mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, uncapped Excluded Claims for confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, plus the carve-out that Customer payment obligations are not 'damages'.

Edit is additive and minimal — existing p0070 text is untouched and the new section is placed in General Provisions where the survival clause reaches it; no unlimited-Customer-liability language remains.
Comment is accurate, first-person plural, states the playbook position and offers the straight 12-months'-fees fallback without lecturing.

Minor, non-blocking: the carve-out references 'indemnification obligations' and 'Termination Payment' although no indemnity clause exists — verify the Termination Payment defined term and Section 3 fee cross-reference on insertion.
